messages:
alex: Quick sync — we're doing a base-image rebuild this week and it requires RBAC tweaks + KMS signer setup. Window proposed: Wed 03:00 UTC. Need owners for RBAC, KMS keys, audit validation, and canary tests.
maria: I can take RBAC. Do we need new roles or just tighten existing ones?
sam: Prefer new minimal roles. Goal: signer SA only has `kms:Sign` and access to the signing secret; runtime pullers get only secret `get` and image verification perms. Also we should prohibit broad create/grant on the key.
priya: On vuln triage: the rebuild will include updates to libssl/glibc. I want a staged canary (5% traffic) for 48h with smoke + regression prompts. If any generation regressions or increased tail latency, abort.
jordan: Audit logging checklist: enable KMS DataAccess logs + admin activity. Ensure CloudTrail/Stackdriver exports include KMS ops and cosign actions. Retention: 180d for now, export to SIEM.
alex: Sam — can you create per-region KMS keys? We want separate keys for us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Key policy must list `image-signer` SA and the CI build role. Also deny `kms:CreateGrant` from outside org.
sam: Yep. Using IRSA for AWS and Workload Identity for GCP so no long-lived creds in pods. Draft policy: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/image-signer"},"Action":["kms:Sign"],"Resource":"*"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Principal":"*","Action":["kms:CreateGrant"],"Condition":{"StringNotEquals":{"aws:PrincipalOrgID":"o-abc123"}}}
  ]
}
```
maria: RBAC snippet I'm drafting (minimal): ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: image-signer-role
  namespace: infra
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["secrets"]
    verbs: ["get", "create"]
---
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: image-signer-binding
  namespace: infra
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: image-signer
    namespace: infra
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: image-signer-role
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
priya: Also add a `runtime-image-verify` ClusterRole that allows pods to read the verification secrets only in runtime namespaces. No write permissions.
jordan: Verification on startup: add `cosign verify --key <kms-uri> <image>` in the init path or use a verification sidecar. We should fail-fast if verification fails. Add a flag to tolerate verification failures during canary only if explicitly enabled.
alex: Who will run the canary tests and alerts? Priya?
priya: I'll own canary + alerts. Alert conditions: >1% error rate OR tail latency p99 increases by >150ms OR any eval regression >5% on quality set. I'll create grafana alerts and an incident runbook.
sam: Created keys in staging. I'll push policies to infra repo and request security review. Links: https://git.company/infra/kms/keys/staging.md
maria: Opening RBAC PR shortly and will tag @sam for the key ARNs. PR will include a docs/README on access model.
sec-bot: Security automation checklist: 1) Key rotation schedule set to 90 days 2) Audit export enabled to SIEM 3) Cross-account grants prohibited by policy 4) Dry-run signing in staging and verification in runtime 5) Keep last 3 signed tags for rollback
jordan: Rollout plan proposal: 1) Create keys + review (Mon) 2) Merge RBAC PR (Tue) 3) Build images + sign in staging (Tue night) 4) Dry-run verify in staging (Tue night) 5) Canary deploy (Wed 03:00 UTC) 6) Observe 48h then full cutover.
alex: Contingencies: if KMS auth errors appear, fallback to previously signed image (we keep last 3). If a binary vuln surfaces that fails smoke tests, pause and rollback. If audit gaps found, pause until SIEM ingestion confirmed.
priya: I'll add a regression prompt suite to the evals repo and wire a webhook to pause rollout if quality drops.
sam: One more IAM detail: ensure build CI role has `kms:Sign` only for the specific keys and no `kms:CreateGrant` permission. We'll also add a guardrail in terraform to prevent accidental wildcard grants.
maria: PR link: https://git.company/repo/pull/1024 (rbac + docs). Please review before Tue EOD.
alex: Thanks — owners are set: maria (RBAC), sam (KMS + IAM policies), priya (canary/tests + alerts), jordan (audit + rollback). I'll post a final runbook and tag ops. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Reminder: add quarterly access review entry for the new keys and schedule a table in the compliance tracker.
priya: Scheduling the canary window and test runs now. I'll ping this thread when smoke results are in.
alex: Perfect. Short follow-up: add a promise to update runtime startup docs with verification command and add a Jira for the verification rollout.
priya: Jira created: INFRA-7123
